info.title: TucanoTime API
info.description: Timesheet system: daily/weekly time entries, customers and project codes with per-entity currencies and hourly rates. File-backed (no database); the API is the only writer below TUCANO_DATA_DIR. Access is private-per-user (#51): a member sees and edits only their own entries/expenses/submissions; an administrator sees all data and owns invoicing, approvals and user management (the /users and /invoices routes return 403 for members). Mutating endpoints may return 503 (Retry-After) under write contention (#62).

ProjectCode.description: Normalised upper case; letters and digits, dashes and underscores after the first character; at most 24 characters.

Hours.description: Hours as a decimal with at most two fractional digits (0.01–24.00). Stored as integer hundredths.

RateMinor.description: Hourly rate in currency minor units (cents). 6000 = 60.00.

email.description: Optional billing email for invoice delivery (#35)

payment_terms.description: Payment terms for the issue-time due date (#116).

invoice_notes.description: Markdown-subset notes appended to this customer's invoice documents (#116).

contacts.description: Billing contacts (#139). When a contact is flagged billing, invoice emails go there.

tax_hundredths.description: Default VAT in hundredths of a percent (2100 = 21.00%). Integer, never float.

Task.description: A task under a project. Tasks have no billing overrides; legacy stored currency/rate fields are ignored.

TaskInput.description: Task billing overrides are not supported. currency and rate_minor are rejected as unknown fields.

user_id.description: The user who logged the entry (attribution, #21).

billable.description: Billable vs non-billable time. Non-billable time is never invoiced.

source.description: Provenance. Server-set; API clients create manual entries.

InvoiceStatus.description: Invoice lifecycle (#27); partly_paid and written_off added by #114.

quantity_hundredths.description: Manual lines: hundredths of a unit (#143).

payments.description: Payment ledger (#114). A legacy paid document without entries counts as fully paid.

outstanding.description: Outstanding BALANCES keyed by currency (#114: total - paid over issued/partly_paid).

partly_paid.description: Open invoices with a partially settled balance (#114).

project_codes.description: Restrict billing to these projects of the customer (#134); empty = all eligible projects.

InvoiceInput.description: Generate a draft from a period's billable work (#8/#134).

PdfHint.description: Metadata for the PDF archived beside the invoice (#113).

PaymentTerms.description: Payment terms deciding the due date at issue (#116).

days.description: Only for `custom` (then required); other kinds must omit it.

InvoiceTemplate.description: Org-wide invoice template (`invoice_template.json`, #116). Empty/unset fields keep legacy behaviour.

body.description: Markdown-subset body before the line table.

InvoicePayment.description: One recorded payment on the invoice ledger (#114).

RecurMode.description: Bill tracked work or a fixed retainer (#26).

active.description: false pauses generation; the billing cursor (last_period_end) is kept (#136).

Address.description: Postal address parts (#139), free text with length bounds.

country.description: Required (min 2 chars) when any address part is set.

Contact.description: Named person at a customer (#139); at most one may be the billing contact.

OrgProfile.description: Company legal identity, stored as org_profile.json (#138). Empty name falls back to the org_name config key.

legal_id.description: VAT / company registration id printed on documents.

from_name.description: Email sender display name (#146); empty = built-in.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address (#146); empty omits the header. Validated.

accent.description: Invoice document accent for the totals section (#146); empty = ink-only.

ManualLineInput.description: A manual Product/Service line as submitted (#143). Quantities are INTEGER hundredths (150 = 1.50) — the API never sees floats.

project_code.description: Optional link to a project of the invoice customer.

InvoiceEditInput.description: Draft-only full replacement (#143). Tracked lines must come back verbatim; manual amounts are recomputed server-side.

LabelOverrides.description: Display-label overrides for invoice documents (#147). Empty = built-in label; API field names never change.

active.description: false = archived; hidden from new picks, history untouched.

Retainer.description: Retainer aggregate; balance is ALWAYS the reconciled ledger (#144).

ValidationError.description: Payload failed validation before any write or side effect.

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with existing state (duplicate, or referenced by entries).

Locked.description: A concurrent writer holds the store lock (#62); transient — retry. Sent with Retry-After.

DateParam.name: date
DateParam.description: Single day, YYYY-MM-DD. Exactly one of date or from+to.

FromParam.name: from
FromParam.description: Inclusive start of a range. Requires to; at most 400 days.
